verdict.rationale: Stable documents registrable webhook endpoints, configured in the dashboard, that notify you about "important events" on your account (stable-docs-4). However, the pack never says which events fire, so new-mail and scan-complete triggers specifically are unconfirmed. The docs also recommend polling for location state changes (stable-docs-6), and Slack/email alerts (stable-docs-16) do not count as webhooks. Missing for 10: a documented event catalog covering mail-arrived and scan-completed, a Zapier trigger, payload/signature/retry documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
